set.body:
Outcome

Prove the unified API from outside its implementation packages.

Acceptance

- A clean consumer compiles one predictive and one relational workflow from documented dependencies.
- Examples exercise real plans and typed results, not placeholders.
- The shortest raw-input-to-result path is recorded and understandable.
- Bind and execution failures render actionable axis, role, stage, capability, and provenance context.
set.title: P7.5: compile clean downstream consumers and executable public documentation
